trial_title: The Dutch Asymptomatic Mitral Regurgitation Trial
brief_summary: The purpose of this study is to compare early mitral valve repair versus a watchful waiting strategy in asymptomatic patients with severe organic mitral valve regurgitation and preserved left ventricular function.

eligibility_table.justification: The patient has severe mitral valve prolapse with regurgitation, which suggests symptomatic issues, thus not asymptomatic.
The patient has severe mitral valve prolapse with regurgitation, which qualifies as severe organic mitral valve regurgitation.
